commits.summary: Exercise all three gated Spring edits (verification pending)
commits.body:
Compare 98,304 real Spring Security and DataBinder histories with an independent graph and two-object model, and with the previously checked release decisions and all ordered binder prefixes. Four fresh JVMs alternate the order of the two routes. The submitted job 20261122-190127-check-every-role-gated-spring-edit-histo records every observation and the cost of requalifying and consuming the earlier receipts.

Both single-history wrong-caller controls reproduced on Temurin 21.0.13. One kept the final error while changing a child name, and the other kept both child values while introducing an error. Both example validators, all eight oracle tables, the existing scorecards and the changed tests passed. The JBMC stand-in process test passed on automatic retry.
